OFFICE OF THE MAYOR
---
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 97
CREATION OF URBAN HOMESTEADING DEMONSTRATION AREA
Whereas, It is a policy of the City that existing housing stock and residential neighbor-hoods be maintained and, where necessary, rehabilitated to provide decent, safe and sanitary housing; and

Whereas, A proposal has been submitted to the United States Department of Housing and Urban Development ("HUD") for a demonstration project of sweat equity homesteading in multiple dwellings located in part of the lower east side of Manhattan ("the Neighborhood"); and
Whereas, HUD intends to fund a demonstration project of sweat equity homesteading based upon certain terms and conditions; and
Whereas, One of the conditions of HUD is the designation by the City of the Neighborhood as an Urban Homesteading Demonstration Area.
Now, therefore, it is hereby ordered as follows:
Section 1. *Creation of Urban Homesteading Demonstration Area.*
The area in the lower east side of Manhattan bounded as follows is established as an Urban Homesteading Demonstration Area for a three year period commencing on December 15, 1977:
All those certain lots, pieces or parcels of land, situate lying and being in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, within the area bounded and described as follows:

running thence easterly along the southerly lot line of said Lot 5 and continuing along the northerly lot line of Lot 58 to the westerly lot line of Lot 11; thence southerly along the westerly lot line of Lot 11 to the northerly side of East 3d Street;
